technical.summary: ENPH shows strong momentum with volume spike and three white soldiers pattern, but overbought RSI conditions and weak short-term moving average alignment create pullback risk; moderate entry quality with elevated caution warranted.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 104 days create a weak fundamental setup with elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (31 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional purchases (9+ months old) and absent recent news sentiment provide minimal conviction support.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (299.68) indicates extreme market fear, though earnings in 104 days poses minimal near-term event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical momentum (vol spike 15x, three white soldiers, RSI 76.55) combined with extreme market fear (VIX crisis levels) creates a classic contrarian buy setup with support at 258.24 providing defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI, failed moving average alignment (EMA/SMA both bearish), weak accumulation (CMF false), inverted yield curve, and price positioned near resistance (270.91) with macro headwinds create elevated pullback risk that outweighs momentum strength.
